title: Exact quantum factoring over a fixed finite gate set

result.label: Exact quantum factoring over a fixed finite gate set
result.statement: Gives a polynomial-time uniform quantum circuit family that outputs the complete prime factorization of every integer with probability one. Both gate count and qubit count are polynomial in the input length, and one fixed finite gate set suffices.
